name: articles-mcp
purpose: Search and read published articles from multiple MCP clients
endpoints: Hearthpulse OAuth issuer JWKS and current reader-permissions
authentication: HTTP: OAuth JWT access token (MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER, MCP_OAUTH_JWKS_URL, MCP_PERMISSIONS_CLIENT_SECRET). STDIO: local process access. Staging source: MCP_STAGING_SOURCE_AUTHORIZATION only.
data_classes: public article text and public taxonomy

retry.conditions: Next scheduled synchronization after failure; no inline retries

idempotency: Upsert by source-bound article ID; atomic index activation after complete catalog traversal
rate_limit: HTTP: 60 requests/minute/subject, 300 total/minute, 4 active tool requests; source batches <=100 metadata or 25 bodies, >=200ms pause; 429 is returned with Retry-After
observability: Sync emits counts; staging probe emits timings and byte counts. No tokens, article bodies, search strings or subject IDs in logs.
degradation: Source validation failure withholds all affected tool results. Failed sync preserves committed index. Removed/private/password protected articles are withheld by live checks.
disable_switch: Stop MCP HTTP process and sync timer; existing WordPress continues independently
